title: token_dashboard: durable token store + ingester (dashboard core)
objective: Ingest Claude Code transcripts and aux sources into a durable, migrated SQLite store that the control-panel /tokens page reads, with an incremental pass under 60 s and 0 LLM tokens.
acceptance_criteria: python_pkg/token_dashboard and python_pkg/token_audit stay at 100% line and branch coverage; every file <= 250 lines
python3 -m python_pkg.token_dashboard.ingest --budget 40 finishes in under 60 s and is resumable
schema.connect migrates a v1/v2 store forward without deleting rows
calls/marks/turn_detail rows are replaced, never duplicated, when a transcript is re-walked
verifier: pytest --cov=python_pkg/token_dashboard --cov=python_pkg/token_audit --cov-branch; the ingest command; pre-commit hooks on the staged files
